articles.title: CFTC chief poses questions about policing AI but calls it a road to 'autonomous trading'
articles.snippet: The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission held a forum in which the chairman, Mike Selig, suggested AI agents may usher in a financial revolution.

articles.title: Crypto isn’t a partisan fight, proven by data
articles.snippet: Treating crypto as a political battleground only makes it harder to build the secure, transparent, American-made financial system that most Americans say they want, argues DeFi Education Fund’s Jennifer Rosenthal.

articles.title: Majority of Americans want candidates who support US-based financial technology: Poll
articles.snippet: The September survey offered a possible window into US voters who could consider fintech and digital asset policies on Election Day.

articles.title: Polymarket Has Investigated 'Dozens' of Midterm Election Bets: Report
